pairs.statement: The specialised commercial court decides by a judgment open to appeal before the judicial council.
When the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: Central and national decisions are assigned to another court: «وتختص المحكمة الإدارية للاستئناف للجزائر بالفصل كدرجة أولى». Article 801 names specific issuing bodies; it does not establish the blanket public-party-or-administrative-decision rule.

pairs.statement: When the matter is before the criminal judge, a handwriting-comparison claim is deferred until the criminal action is decided.
Lack of subject-matter jurisdiction is of public order and the court declares it of its own motion at any stage.

When specialised commercial matter is one of intellectual_property, commercial_company, bankruptcy_settlement, bank_with_merchant, maritime_air_insurance, international_trade and not (specialised commercial courts installed is no), the case leaves the ordinary courts (specialisedCommercialCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The automatic routing omits cases retained by the existing jurisdictions: «وتبقى الجهات القضائية الإدارية والأقسام التجارية مختصة بالفصل في الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامها قبل تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة».

pairs.statement: Civil servants, contract agents of public bodies and administrations, and staff of public administrative bodies are governed by special provisions, not by the labour relations law.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT subjects these personnel to special legislative and regulatory provisions, but does not expressly exclude application of the labour relations law.

pairs.statement: If the administration answers in time, a period of two months runs from notification of the refusal.
Failure to respect a period of the code for exercising a right or a remedy forfeits the right, except for force majeure or events affecting the normal working of the courts.
The creditor receives an official copy of the order, which is formally served on the debtor with a demand to pay within fifteen (15) days.
The judge lacks jurisdiction over the merits if arbitral proceedings are pending or an arbitration agreement exists and a party raises it.
The period for an action before the administrative court is four months from personal notification of an individual decision or publication of a collective or regulatory decision.
If conciliation fails, the claim is filed with the record of non-conciliation attached, on pain of inadmissibility in form.
An order on petition is a provisional order made without the other party, unless the law says otherwise.
Urgent matters, judicial sequestration and protective measures are brought by petition before the competent court.
pairs.missingOrWrong: For protective measures, the TEXT specifies those not governed by special procedures: «غير منظم بإجراءات خاصة». It does not establish the stated procedure for every protective measure.

pairs.statement: When employer in bankruptcy or settlement is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (specialisedCommercialCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT assigns judicial-settlement and bankruptcy disputes to the specialised commercial court, not every case involving an employer in bankruptcy or settlement. It also makes the jurisdiction rules effective only from installation of the new courts.

pairs.statement: The territorial rules of the code apply to the specialised commercial court.
If no objection is made in time, the order acquires the force of res judicata and the enforcement formula is granted.
pairs.missingOrWrong: Granting the enforcement formula additionally requires presentation of a certificate of non-objection: «بعد تقديم شهادة عدم الاعتراض». The statement omits this condition.

pairs.statement: The administrative courts hear actions to annul, interpret or review the legality of decisions of the wilaya, the decentralised State services, the commune, regional professional organisations and local public administrative bodies.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The State services named by the TEXT are specifically those at wilaya level: «على مستوى الولاية». It does not establish the same jurisdiction for State services at other levels.

pairs.statement: An order refusing the request cannot be challenged, and the creditor keeps the right to file a claim under its rules.
The president rules on the request by order within five (5) days of its filing.
The civil judge is bound by a criminal judgment only on the facts it decided where deciding them was necessary.
When the petition asks for payment and debt written fixed due is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (paymentOrder).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The procedure is optional: «يجوز للدائن». The right to file a claim remains: «دون المساس بحق الدائن في رفع دعوى وفقا للقواعد المقررة لها». There is no mandatory departure from the ordinary courts.

pairs.statement: Disputes of civil servants, State agents and staff of public administrative bodies must be brought before the administrative court of the place where they work.
The lodging of the grievance is proved by any written means and attached to the petition.
The administrative courts also hear full-jurisdiction actions and the cases given to them by special texts.
If the last day of the period is not a working day, the period runs to the next working day.
The period is interrupted by an action brought before a court without jurisdiction.
The subject-matter and territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts are of public order.

The time limit is 2 months, running from the date of administrative grievance rejection date; it is a forfeiture period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes) and administrative grievance filed is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: For a timely express refusal, the starting event is «من تاريخ تبليغ الرفض», not the date the refusal was made. For silence, it is «من تاريخ انتهاء أجل الشهرين (2)». The stated cancellation/public-party applicability test is also not supplied.

pairs.statement: An order to pay for which the enforcement formula is not requested within one (1) year of its date lapses and has no effect.

A creditor of a sum of money that is due, payable, fixed and proven in writing may, instead of the rules for filing a claim, petition the president of the court of the debtor's domicile for an order to pay.
By exception, the ordinary courts hear road offences.
Before a case is entered at the specialised commercial court, a conciliation is held at a party's request before a judge its president appoints.
The tribunal is the court of general jurisdiction and decides all cases, in particular civil, commercial, maritime, social, real-property and family cases.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT limits the cases to those within the tribunal's territorial jurisdiction: «والتي تختص بها إقليميا». The statement omits this qualification.

pairs.statement: The time limit is 4 months, running from the date of administrative decision notice date; it is a forfeiture period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes) and not (administrative grievance filed is yes).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The starting event depends on the decision: «التبليغ الشخصي بنسخة من القرار الإداري الفردي» or «نشر القرار الإداري الجماعي أو التنظيمي», rather than one general notice date. Opposability also requires mention of the period in the notification. The stated public-party/no-grievance applicability test is not supplied.

pairs.statement: A grievance may be lodged with the authority that made the decision within the period of the court action.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT permits a grievance within the period referred to in Article 829, but that article's contents are absent; this excerpt does not identify it as the court-action period.

pairs.statement: Claims for compensation of damage from a crime, an offence, a petty offence or a tort are brought before the court of the place of the harmful act.
By exception, the ordinary courts hear liability claims for compensation of damage caused by a vehicle belonging to the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body.

The time limit is 1 year, running from the date of payment order date; it is a procedural period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for payment and payment order issued is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The year concerns requesting the enforcement formula. The TEXT does not expressly classify it as a procedural period. Article 405 excludes notification/service days and the ending day, but does not expressly exclude the issuance day from this issuance-based period.

pairs.statement: The period is suspended by a request for legal aid and by force majeure or a sudden event.
When worker is public servant is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT requires administrative courts for the listed public-service disputes. It does not say that a worker's public-servant status alone transfers every case regardless of its subject or another court's assigned jurisdiction.

pairs.statement: Two months of silence on the grievance count as a refusal, after which the complainant has two months to bring the court action, from the end of the silence.
The periods of the code are counted in full; neither the day of notification nor the day the period ends is counted.
The new subject-matter and territorial rules for the administrative courts and the specialised commercial courts apply from the installation of the new courts.
The administrative courts have general jurisdiction over administrative disputes, except those given to other courts.
An urgent order does not touch the substance of the right and is provisionally enforceable.
Arbitration is open for rights the person may freely dispose of, not for matters of public order, status or capacity.

The specialised commercial court hears disputes of intellectual property, commercial companies, judicial settlement and bankruptcy, banks and financial institutions with merchants, maritime, air transport and insurance linked to commercial activity, and international trade.
An arbitration clause is an agreement in a contract on freely disposable rights to submit disputes about it to arbitration.
The objection is made as an urgent matter before the judge who made the order, and it suspends its enforcement.
Tax, public works, administrative contract, medical service, supply and harmful-act compensation disputes must be brought before administrative courts fixed by place.

The administrative courts hear at first instance every case to which the State, a wilaya, a commune, a public administrative body, a national public body or a national professional organisation is a party.
Any party may plead lack of jurisdiction at any stage, and the judge must raise it of his own motion.
The paragraphs of the code on the specialised poles of the courts, and other articles of the code, were repealed.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT repeals paragraphs 7–10 of Article 32 and the listed other articles, but does not identify the repealed paragraphs as provisions on specialised judicial poles.

pairs.statement: When criminal case on same facts is yes or (obligation is tort compensation is yes and damage caused by offence is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (criminalCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT concerns the limited binding effect of a criminal judgment on the civil judge and territorial venue for damages: «أمام الجهة القضائية التي وقع في دائرة اختصاصها الفعل الضار». It does not transfer such cases to a criminal court.

pairs.statement: A petition to annul, interpret or review an administrative decision must attach the contested decision, on pain of inadmissibility, unless there is a justified obstacle.
When public body party is yes and not (the petition asks for damages and public vehicle damage is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT expressly provides another ordinary-court exception: «يكون من اختصاص المحاكم العادية المنازعات الآتية» and «1 - مخالفات الطرق». Excluding public-vehicle damage alone therefore does not establish the stated rule.

pairs.statement: The commercial section hears commercial disputes except those given to the specialised commercial court.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT excepts disputes mentioned in Article 536 bis, but this excerpt does not identify those disputes as assigned to the specialised commercial court.

pairs.statement: All documents proving the debt are attached to the request for an order to pay.
The specialised commercial court hears judicial settlement and bankruptcy disputes.
The demand to pay must state, on pain of nullity, the debtor's right to object within fifteen (15) days of formal service.

The time limit is 15 days, running from the date of payment order notified on; it is a procedural period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for payment and payment order issued is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not expressly classify the period as procedural. It specifies formal service («التبليغ الرسمي») as the objection-period trigger and distinguishes the fifteen-day payment demand from the fifteen-day objection period.

pairs.statement: If the debt appears established, the debtor is ordered to pay it with the costs; otherwise the request is refused.
The territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts follows the general rules on the defendant's domicile.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to Articles 37 and 38 without giving their contents; it does not itself say that territorial jurisdiction follows the defendant's domicile.

pairs.statement: The administrative court of appeal of Algiers hears at first instance actions to annul, interpret or review decisions of central administrative authorities, national public bodies and national professional organisations.

The petition gives the identity of the creditor and the debtor and their real or chosen domicile in Algeria, the details of any legal person, and a short statement of the cause and amount of the debt.
The period may be set against the claimant only if the notification of the decision mentions it.
The administrative courts and commercial sections keep the cases filed before them before the installation.
